info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities My Events API
Return the data for all of my in-app notification events

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of MyEvent records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.
